faqs.question: What is Alpha Capital Group?
faqs.answer: Alpha Capital Group is a UK proprietary trading firm incorporated in November 2021 and headquartered in London. Traders pass an Alpha One, Alpha Pro, Alpha Swing or Alpha Three evaluation to become a Qualified Analyst on a simulated account, with sizes from $5,000 to $200,000 and combined allocation up to $400,000 before scaling.

seo.title: What is Alpha Capital Group? | Prop Firm FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Alpha Capital Group is a UK prop firm founded in 2021, running Alpha One, Pro, Swing and Three evaluation programmes.

faqs.question: What is the Alpha Capital Group performance fee split?
faqs.answer: Alpha Capital Group calls its profit split a "performance fee." The standard split pays 80% to the trader and 20% to the firm on eligible simulated profits. Alpha Direct and other upgraded plans can pay a 90% performance fee instead, and the split can rise further as accounts move through the scaling plan.

seo.title: Alpha Capital Group Performance Fee: 80% to 90% | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Alpha Capital Group pays an 80% standard performance fee, rising to 90% on Alpha Direct and upgraded plans.

faqs.question: How often can I withdraw from Alpha Capital Group?
faqs.answer: Standard Alpha Pro, Alpha Swing and Alpha Three plans pay performance fees on a bi-weekly schedule once you become a Qualified Analyst. Alpha Direct and certain upgraded plans instead support on-demand requests, subject to minimum profit and a 40% best-day consistency rule. Support and payment processing run Monday to Friday, 8am–8pm GMT.

seo.title: Alpha Capital Group Payout Cycle | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Alpha Capital Group pays bi-weekly by default, with on-demand requests available on Alpha Direct and upgraded plans.

faqs.question: What withdrawal methods and fees does Alpha Capital Group use?
faqs.answer: Alpha Capital Group processes performance fees via bank wire (minimum $100, 1–3 business days) or cryptocurrency (minimum $100, usually same-day). The firm does not add its own withdrawal commission; the evaluation fee is also refunded once a trader's first performance fee is successfully paid out.

seo.title: Alpha Capital Group Withdrawal Methods and Fees | FAQ
seo.metaDescription: Alpha Capital Group charges no internal payout fee across bank wire and crypto, and refunds the evaluation fee on first payout.

faqs.question: How does the Alpha Capital Group scaling plan work?
faqs.answer: On Alpha Pro, Alpha Swing and Alpha Three accounts, every time your balance grows 10% you can request a scale-up together with your performance fee withdrawal: the account increases by 10% of the initial balance, and from your second scale-up onward the maximum lot size also rises 10%. There's no fixed waiting period between scale-ups, only a 5-trading-day minimum after each one, and combined virtual capital growth is capped at $2,000,000.

seo.title: Alpha Capital Group Scaling Plan Explained | FAQ
